content.title: Get tickets to Timberwolves vs. Rockets tonight: game preview, injury updates & where to watch on TV or stream | Minnesota Timberwolves
content.text: The Minnesota Timberwolves are back in action Wednesday with a home matchup against the Houston Rockets at Target Center.Minnesota is coming off a historic 102–92 road win over the Boston Celtics on Sunday, snapping an 18-game losing streak in Boston that dated back to 2005. Bones Hyland led the way with 23 points, while Jaden McDaniels added 19 points and Rudy Gobert grabbed 14 rebounds. Ayo Dosunmu continued his versatile play with 17 points, eight rebounds and six assists, and Naz Reid provided a spark off the bench with 11 points in his return from injury.Fifth in the West at 44–28, Minnesota is 5–5 over their last 10 and 24–13 at home. The Wolves rank eighth in defense (112.4 defensive rating) and 12th in offense (116.0 offensive rating).Here’s what to know heading into Wednesday’s Timberwolves–Rockets matchup, including how to get tickets, where to watch or stream and the latest injury updates.Timberwolves vs. Rockets tickets, doors & start timeTickets: Get TicketsDoors: 7:30 PMStart Time: 8:30 PMDoors for this 8:30 PM game will open at 7:30 PM. Fans are encouraged to arrive early to ensure a smooth entry and avoid delays. Downloading the new Timberwolves app will help make entry even faster.You can get tickets to the game here.How to watch, stream & listen to Timberwolves vs. RocketsDate: Wednesday, March 25Start Time: 8:30 PM CTTV Channel/Live Stream: FanDuel Sports Network | ESPNRadio: iHeartRadio | Timberwolves app | KFAN 100.3Where: Target Center | Minneapolis, MNWolves vs. Rockets tips off at 8:30 PM on Wednesday, March 25 from Target Center in downtown Minneapolis. The game will be broadcast and streamed on FanDuel Sports Network and ESPNInjury ReportNote: Tonight's injury report will be updated before the start of the game.Timberwolves Out: Ayo Dosunmu, Anthony Edwards, Rocco Zikarsky, Enrique Freeman & Zyon PullinAyo Dosunmu (Right Calf Soreness), Anthony Edwards (Right Knee Soreness), Rocco Zikarsky, (G League Two-Way), Enrique Freeman (G League Two-Way) and Zyon Pullin (G League Two-Way) are out.RocketsOut: Fred VanVleet & Steven AdamsFred VanVleet (Right Knee ACL Repair) and Steven Adams (Left Ankle Surgey) are out.Jerseys Timberwolves: Classic EditionRockets: City EditionThe Wolves will be in their black trees-themed Classic Edition uniforms against the Rockets, who will be in their white City Edition uniforms.What to know about the RocketsSixth in the West at 43–28, Houston sits just a half-game behind Minnesota in the standings. The Rockets are looking to bounce back after their most recent loss, having gone 5–5 over their last 10 games.Wednesday marks the second of three meetings between the two teams this season. Houston leads the season series 1–0 after winning the first matchup at home in mid-January.The Rockets' rotation is led by Kevin Durant and Alperen Şengün, who recently posted a 33-point triple-double. Their core also features Jabari Smith Jr., Amen Thompson and second-year guard Reed Sheppard. Rounding out the rotation are Tari Eason, Clint Capela, Aaron Holiday, Dorian Finney-Smith, Jae'Sean Tate and Josh Okogie.
